observers.label: Caption-blind observer 1 (Claude)

answers.1: Back of a person's head and neck, from behind and slightly right; the right ear is the focus. Four panels.
answers.2: Panel 1: white cloth band around the head at forehead level, bow at the back; white rounded pad over the ear. Panel 2: a hand pulls the band's loose tail backward; pad already gone, ear bare. Panel 3: no band or pad; a thin pale curved line in the crease behind the ear. Panel 4: magnified ear; a tan rounded strip lies tilted across that line, behind the upper ear.
answers.3: Navy circles "1"–"4", top-left of each panel (sequence). Teal arrow, panel 2, above the hand, pointing away from the head (pull direction). Magnifying glass, panel 4. Pill label "Tape?" beneath it, a question.
answers.4: Reversed, or with the arrow read as "pull tight," it shows a head being wrapped. The tan strip could pass for a wound.
answers.5: Pull the band's tail backward to undo it; band and pad come off, per the 1–3 order. Then look behind the ear for a tan strip. Whether that strip stays, comes off, or goes on: cannot tell.
